info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Advanced Voice Services Status API
info.description: The Advanced Voice Services Status API enables users to monitor the operational status of key banking services utilizing advanced voice technologies. By leveraging this API, developers can fetch real-time status updates on various operational aspects of voice service channels. This functionality is crucial for businesses that rely on voice services for customer interactions and need to ensure optimal performance and availability. Typical consumers of this API include system integrators, banking application developers, and operations teams seeking to enhance user experiences through reliable service monitoring.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of advanced voice services operations for a specific channel.
get.description: This API endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current status of advanced voice services operations related to a particular channel. It provides insights into the operational state and can assist in monitoring and troubleshooting issues.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of advanced voice services operations specific to a channel. This body should conform to the defined schema to ensure proper handling of the request.

200.description: The request was successful and the current status is returned.
